tools.name: threat-intelligence_public-threat-feed-aggregate
tools.description: Aggregate caller-supplied and verified key-free public threat feeds (CISA KEV, OpenPhish, capped PhishTank). URLhaus/ThreatFox require auth and are not queried. Feed hits are not confirmed malice. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/public-threat-feed-aggregate. An unpaid call returns

tools.name: threat-intelligence_ioc-context-enrich
tools.description: Enrich supplied IPs, domains, URLs, and hashes using caller context plus optional public DNS/feeds. A single weak feed hit is never classified as malicious. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/ioc-context-enrich. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: threat-intelligence_domain-threat-history
tools.description: Analyze publicly accessible domain history and DNS/RDAP context from caller fields and optional key-free public lookups. History attributes alone are not malice. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/domain-threat-history. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: threat-intelligence_certificate-threat-cluster
tools.description: Identify relationships between domains using caller-supplied certificates and optional public crt.sh data. Shared certificate attributes are linkage evidence, not confirmed abuse. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/certificate-threat-cluster. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment t

tools.name: threat-intelligence_typosquatting-domain-detect
tools.description: Identify domains resembling supplied brand or company domains using local string/keyboard heuristics. Resemblance alone is not confirmed phishing. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/typosquatting-domain-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: threat-intelligence_phishing-infrastructure-cluster
tools.description: Group related phishing domains and infrastructure using caller evidence and optional public phishing feeds. Clusters are relationship hypotheses, not confirmed campaigns. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/phishing-infrastructure-cluster. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

tools.name: threat-intelligence_exposed-service-risk-analyze
tools.description: Analyze caller-supplied external service inventory and scan results for exposure risk. Never initiates intrusive network scanning. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/exposed-service-risk-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: threat-intelligence_threat-indicator-confidence-score
tools.description: Calculate explainable confidence scores for supplied threat indicators using multi-source corroboration. Single weak signals are capped and never claimed as confirmed malice. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/threat-intelligence/threat-indicator-confidence-score. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment
